title: Plan a Graded Return
subtitle: Build toward an activity that matters without making recovery all-or-nothing.
description: This is a planning exercise, not permission to push through concerning symptoms. Follow the plan you and your practitioner have agreed upon.

fields.label: What activity would you like to return to?
fields.placeholder: Work task, walk, sport, hobby, household task...

fields.label: Why does this activity matter to you?
What is the smallest useful version you could try?
fields.placeholder: For example: 10 minutes, lighter resistance, fewer repetitions...

fields.label: How will you know the starting dose is manageable?
What will you adjust if it is too much—or too easy?

successMessage: Plan saved. Review it with your practitioner when guidance or safety considerations are needed.
